buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at

the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Specifications of Rejection wood. S No. Parameters Specification 01 i. Dry General ii. Duly Chopped in blocks iii Dust free and free from other impurities iv. High grade combustible. 02 Plank size Between 6 & 12 inch 03 Wood type Preferably Deodar Phlai, Bhrank, kiker, willow, popla r and fruit trees (apple mango, almond & chestnut etc) 04 General Free from dust and other impurities Eligibility Criteria · The bidder must be a registered supplier under GeM or recognized government procurement system. ·Must have experience of similar supply in government/semi-government/PSU organizations during the last 3 years. · Must possess valid GST registration, PAN, and bank account details. · The firm should not have been blacklisted or debarred by any government agency. · GST clearance certificate. · Annual turnover above 30 lacs. · Income tax return for last 03 years. · All supporting documents must be uploaded along with the technical bid. Terms and Conditions · Supply of rejection wood as per above specifications within the specified delivery schedule. ·Quoted rates shall be inclusive of all applicable taxes, duties, transportation, and delivery charges. · Payment shall be made after satisfactory delivery, inspection, and acceptance of material by the comp etent authority, upon submission of the original GST invoice in triplicate along with delivery challan. · Delay in supply will attract a penalty @ 0.5% per day of the total order value. · Supplied material not conforming to the specification will be rejected and must be replaced within 7 days at the supplier’s cost. Bid Evaluation and Award ·The bid shall be evaluated in two stages – Technical Bid and Financial Bid with Reverse Auction. · Only technically qualified bidders shall participate in the financial stage. · The lowest (L1) price discovered through reverse auction or financial evaluation shall be considered for a ward of contract. · Qualification in the technical bid does not entitle the bidder to supply unless declared L1. .
